naam: Arm voorwaarts laten zakken – met stok (excentrisch)
pose_en: She stands upright, seen from the side, facing left. She holds a straight stick horizontally with BOTH hands, shoulder-width apart, and both arms are raised straight forward and up so the stick is above her head. The arrow is a long curved arrow starting at her right hand and going forward and DOWN in a big arc to beside her right thigh, showing the right arm being lowered slowly forward and down.
eind_en: END position: her right arm has been lowered forward and down and now hangs straight beside her body; her left hand alone still holds the stick raised above her head. Both figures seen from the side, facing left.

naam: Arm zijwaarts laten zakken – met stok (excentrisch)
pose_en: She stands upright, seen from the FRONT. Her right arm is straight and raised SIDEWAYS (out to her right side) to above shoulder height, the right hand holding one end of a straight stick; her left hand holds the other end of the stick low in front of her left hip, so the stick runs diagonally across her body and supports the right arm. The arrow is a long curved arrow from the right hand going sideways DOWN in an arc to beside her right thigh, showing the right arm being lowered slowly sideways.
eind_en: END position: seen from the front, her right arm has been lowered sideways and now hangs straight beside her body (no longer holding the stick); her left hand holds the stick hanging down beside her left leg.

naam: Schouder naar binnen draaien in 90 graden – met elastiek
pose_en: Frame her from the hips up, seen in a THREE-QUARTER FRONT view (her body turned about 45 degrees to the viewer's left), so the right arm is large and clearly visible. Her right upper arm is lifted out to the SIDE to exactly shoulder height (horizontal) and the right ELBOW IS BENT AT A RIGHT ANGLE, forming a clear L-shape - the arm is never straight. STARTING position: the right forearm points straight UP to the ceiling (the 'hands up' goalpost position), the hand holding an elastic band that runs straight BACKWARD to an anchor on a door behind her at head height. The arrow is a curved arrow at the right hand going FORWARD and DOWN by a quarter circle, showing the forearm tipping forward around the elbow while the elbow stays in place.
eind_en: END position: same framing and view, the right upper arm still horizontal out to the side at shoulder height and the elbow still bent at a right angle, but the forearm now points straight FORWARD, horizontal, at shoulder height, stretching the band to the anchor behind her.
extra_avatar: Frame both figures from the hips up, seen from her RIGHT side at a three-quarter angle (she faces the viewer's left), the door with the band anchor BEHIND her on the viewer's right. In BOTH figures the right upper arm points straight OUT TO THE SIDE toward the viewer, horizontal at exactly shoulder height, and the elbow is bent 90 degrees (L-shape). TOP: forearm points straight UP to the ceiling. BOTTOM: the forearm has tipped forward and points straight FORWARD (toward the viewer's left), horizontal at shoulder height, the elbow still bent 90 degrees and still out to the side - NOT a straight arm reaching forward. The band is pulled taut from the hand back to the door.

naam: Schouder naar buiten draaien in 90 graden – met elastiek
pose_en: Frame her from the hips up, seen in a THREE-QUARTER FRONT view (her body turned about 45 degrees to the viewer's left), so the right arm is large and clearly visible. Her right upper arm is lifted out to the SIDE to exactly shoulder height (horizontal) and the right ELBOW IS BENT AT A RIGHT ANGLE, forming a clear L-shape - the arm is never straight. STARTING position: the right forearm points straight FORWARD, horizontal at shoulder height, the hand holding an elastic band that runs straight FORWARD to an anchor on a door in front of her at chest height. The arrow is a curved arrow at the right hand going UP and BACK by a quarter circle, showing the forearm rotating upward around the elbow while the elbow stays in place.
eind_en: END position: same framing and view, the right upper arm still horizontal out to the side at shoulder height and the elbow still bent at a right angle, but the forearm now points straight UP to the ceiling (the 'hands up' goalpost position), hand beside her head, stretching the band to the anchor in front of her.
extra_avatar: Frame both figures from the hips up, three-quarter front view. In BOTH figures the right arm forms an L-shape: upper arm horizontal out to the side at shoulder height, elbow bent 90 degrees, never a straight arm. TOP: forearm points FORWARD horizontally. BOTTOM: forearm points UP (goalpost). Only the forearm moves, rotating around the elbow. Band to an anchor IN FRONT of her.

naam: Schouderbladen naar achteren – buiklig met armen heffen
pose_en: She lies FACE DOWN (prone) on an exercise mat on the floor, seen from the side, head to the left, forehead resting on a small rolled towel, legs straight. Both arms lie straight alongside her body with the palms facing down. Her shoulders are relaxed. The arrow is a short curved arrow above her right hand pointing UP, showing the arms lifting a few centimetres off the mat.
eind_en: END position: still lying face down with the forehead on the towel and the legs on the mat, she squeezes her shoulder blades together and down and lifts BOTH straight arms a few centimetres off the mat alongside her body, palms facing down. Head stays down.
extra_avatar: EXTREME CLOSE-UP framing seen exactly from the side: show only the head, shoulders, upper back and arms (the body is cut off at the hips). Lying face down, forehead on a towel. TOP: arms rest flat on the mat beside the body. BOTTOM: both straight arms are lifted HIGH off the mat - the hands are about 15 cm above the mat with a large clear gap underneath - and the shoulder blades are visibly squeezed together; head stays down on the towel.

naam: Schouderblad naar achteren – actief
pose_en: She stands upright, seen from the side, facing left, arms hanging relaxed beside her body, the shoulders slightly rounded forward. The arrow is a short curved arrow at her right shoulder pointing BACKWARD and slightly DOWN, showing the shoulder blade being drawn back and down.
eind_en: END position: she stands tall with her shoulders drawn back and down, chest slightly open, shoulder blades pulled together, arms still relaxed beside her body; the shoulders do not lift.
extra_avatar: CLOSE-UP framing: show both figures from the head to the hips only, seen exactly from the side, facing left. TOP: a clearly SLUMPED posture, shoulders rounded far forward, upper back rounded, chest sunken. BOTTOM: upright, shoulders pulled clearly BACK and DOWN, chest open, upper back straight. The difference in shoulder position must be obvious at a glance; arms hang relaxed in both.

naam: Schouder naar buiten draaien – isometrisch tegen de muur
pose_en: Frame her from the hips up. She stands upright, seen from the FRONT, with her RIGHT side next to a wall (the wall on the viewer's left). Her right elbow is bent 90 degrees and held against her side, the forearm pointing forward, and the BACK (outside) of her right wrist presses against the wall. Nothing moves. Draw a short straight arrow at the back of the right wrist pointing INTO the wall, showing the outward push.
eind_en: She holds this position: right elbow bent 90 degrees against her side, back of the right wrist pressing outward against the wall, muscles tensed, nothing moves.
extra_avatar: Frame her from the hips up, seen from the front, wall directly beside her right side, the back of the right wrist clearly touching the wall.

naam: Schouderblad naar achteren – met elastiek
pose_en: Frame her from the knees up. She stands upright, seen from her right side, facing left toward a door. An elastic band is anchored to the door at waist height and she holds one end in each hand, both arms stretched straight forward, the band slightly taut. The arrow is a straight arrow at her right elbow pointing BACKWARD, showing the elbows pulling back along the body.
eind_en: END position: both elbows bent and pulled back alongside the body past the trunk, hands beside the waist, shoulder blades squeezed together, chest open, band stretched to the door.
extra_avatar: Frame both figures from the knees up, seen from the side, door and band anchor clearly visible. TOP: arms straight forward. BOTTOM: elbows pulled far back, shoulder blades squeezed.

naam: Schouder voorwaarts heffen – met stok
pose_en: She stands upright, seen from the side, facing left. She holds a straight stick horizontally in front of her thighs with both hands, shoulder-width apart, arms straight. The arrow is a long curved arrow from her hands going forward and UP in a big arc to above her head, showing the straight arms raising the stick forward and up.
eind_en: END position: both straight arms raised forward and up, the stick held horizontally above her head.

naam: Schouder zijwaarts heffen – met stok
pose_en: She stands upright, seen from the FRONT. She holds a straight stick in front of her body, one hand at each end, the stick horizontal at hip height, arms relaxed. The arrow is a long curved arrow at her right hand going SIDEWAYS and UP, showing the left hand pushing the stick so that the right arm rises sideways.
eind_en: END position: seen from the front, the right arm is raised straight out to the side to above shoulder height, holding one end of the stick; the left hand holds the other end at chest height in front of her body and pushes the stick to the right.

naam: Schouder extensie – actief
pose_en: She stands upright, seen from the side, facing left, both arms hanging straight beside her body, palms facing her thighs. The arrow is a curved arrow at her right hand pointing BACKWARD and up, showing the straight arm moving backward.
eind_en: END position: the right arm is straight and moved backward behind her body as far as comfortable, the trunk stays upright and does not lean forward.
extra_avatar: Seen exactly from the side, facing left. BOTTOM: the straight right arm is clearly moved far BACKWARD behind the body (about 45 degrees behind the trunk), trunk upright.

naam: Arm schuin omhoog trekken – met elastiek
pose_en: She stands upright, seen from the FRONT, standing with her LEFT foot on one end of an elastic band. Her right hand holds the other end LOW in front of her LEFT hip, arm straight and crossed in front of her body. The arrow is a long diagonal arrow from the right hand going UP and OUT to the upper right above her right shoulder, showing the diagonal pull.
eind_en: END position: seen from the front, the right arm is straight and raised diagonally up and out above her right shoulder, thumb pointing backward, the band stretched diagonally across her body from her left foot to her right hand.

naam: Arm schuin omlaag trekken – met elastiek
pose_en: She stands upright, seen from the FRONT. An elastic band is anchored HIGH on a door to her right, above head height. Her right hand holds the band with the arm straight and raised diagonally UP and OUT to the upper right. The arrow is a long diagonal arrow from the right hand going DOWN and ACROSS her body toward her left hip.
eind_en: END position: seen from the front, the straight right arm has been pulled diagonally down across her body, the right hand now beside her LEFT hip, the band stretched from the high anchor to her hand.

naam: Borstspier rekken tegen de muur
pose_en: Frame her from the knees up. She stands with her RIGHT side next to a wall, seen from the side. Her right arm is straight and stretched slightly BACKWARD, the right palm flat on the wall at shoulder height behind her. She has stepped forward with the left foot and her chest is turned slightly AWAY from the wall. No arrow needed except one small curved arrow at her chest showing the trunk turning away from the wall.
eind_en: She holds the stretch: right palm flat on the wall at shoulder height behind her, arm straight, a step forward, chest turned away from the wall.
extra_avatar: Frame her from the knees up. The wall is clearly visible; her right palm is on the wall BEHIND her at shoulder height and her chest turns away from it.

naam: Schouder naar buiten draaien met stok – staand
pose_en: Frame her from the hips up, seen from the FRONT. She holds a straight stick horizontally in front of her belly with both hands, both elbows bent 90 degrees and held against her sides, palms facing up, forearms pointing forward. The arrow is a curved arrow at her RIGHT hand going OUTWARD to the side, showing the right forearm rotating outward, pushed by the left hand via the stick.
eind_en: END position: seen from the front, the right elbow stays against her side, the right forearm has rotated OUTWARD to point out to the right side; the left hand has pushed the stick across toward the right, the left hand now in front of her belly.
extra_avatar: Frame both figures from the hips up, seen from the front. The right elbow stays pressed against her side in both; only the right forearm turns outward.

naam: Schouder naar buiten draaien met stok – ruglig
pose_en: She lies on her BACK on an exercise mat, seen from above at an angle, knees bent, feet flat. Her right upper arm rests on the mat beside her body on a small cushion, elbow bent 90 degrees, forearm pointing up to the ceiling. Both hands hold a stick: the right hand at one end, the left hand further along. The arrow is a curved arrow at the right hand going OUTWARD and down toward the mat, showing the right forearm rotating outward, pushed by the left hand via the stick.
eind_en: END position: still lying on her back, the right elbow stays beside her body on the cushion, the right forearm has rotated outward and down toward the mat, pushed by the stick held in the left hand across her body.
extra_avatar: Lying on the back on a mat, seen from above at an angle so both arms and the stick are clearly visible; the right elbow stays beside her body in both figures.

naam: Schouder naar buiten draaien – arm zijwaarts op tafel
pose_en: Frame her from the hips up. She sits upright on a chair, seen from the FRONT, next to a table on her right. Her right upper arm rests SIDEWAYS on the table, out to the side almost at shoulder height, elbow bent 90 degrees, forearm lying flat on the table pointing forward. The arrow is a curved arrow at the right hand going UP, showing the forearm rotating upward while the upper arm stays on the table.
eind_en: END position: the right upper arm still rests sideways on the table, elbow bent 90 degrees, but the forearm now points straight UP to the ceiling.
extra_avatar: Frame both figures from the hips up, seen from the front, table on her right side clearly visible with the upper arm lying on it in both figures.

naam: Schouder naar buiten draaien – zijlig
pose_en: She lies on her LEFT side on an exercise mat, seen from the front, head resting on a pillow, knees slightly bent. Her right (upper) elbow is bent 90 degrees, the upper arm held against her side with a small rolled towel between arm and body, the right forearm resting across her belly. The arrow is a curved arrow at the right hand going UP toward the ceiling, showing the forearm rotating upward.
eind_en: END position: still lying on her left side, the right elbow stays against her side on the towel, the right forearm has rotated UP and points to the ceiling.
extra_avatar: Lying on her left side, seen from the front. In BOTH figures the right ELBOW stays bent 90 degrees and pressed against her side (a towel between upper arm and body) - the arm is NEVER straight and the upper arm never lifts. TOP: forearm rests across the belly. BOTTOM: only the forearm has rotated up so the hand points to the ceiling, elbow still on the side.

naam: Sleeper stretch – zijlig
pose_en: She lies on her RIGHT side on an exercise mat, seen from the front, head on a pillow, knees bent. Her right upper arm lies on the mat straight out in front of her chest at shoulder height, the right elbow bent 90 degrees, forearm pointing up. Her left hand holds the right wrist and presses the right forearm gently DOWN toward the mat. A small curved arrow at the right hand points forward and down toward the mat.
eind_en: She holds the stretch: lying on her right side, right upper arm in front of her at shoulder height, right forearm pressed forward and down toward the mat by her left hand.
extra_avatar: Lying on the right side, seen from the front, both hands and the right forearm clearly visible.

naam: Armen naar voren schuiven over de tafel
pose_en: She sits on a chair, seen from the side, facing left, at a table. Her forearms and hands rest on a towel on the table close to her body, back upright. The arrow is a long straight arrow along the table from her hands pointing FORWARD, showing the arms sliding forward.
eind_en: END position: both arms slid far forward over the table on the towel, straight, her trunk bent forward and her head lowered between her arms.

naam: Vingers langs de muur omhoog lopen
pose_en: Frame her from the knees up. She stands facing a wall, seen from the side, about a forearm's length away. The fingertips of her right hand touch the wall at chest height. The arrow is a straight arrow along the wall from her fingers pointing UP.
eind_en: END position: her right arm is raised high, the fingertips have walked up the wall above her head, her shoulder stays low.

naam: Handen achter het hoofd, ellebogen openen – ruglig
pose_en: She lies on her BACK on an exercise mat, seen from above at an angle, knees bent, feet flat. Her hands are clasped behind her head and both elbows point up to the ceiling. The arrows are two small curved arrows at the elbows pointing OUTWARD and down toward the mat.
eind_en: END position: still lying on her back with hands clasped behind the head, both elbows have opened outward and down toward the mat.
extra_avatar: Seen from above at an angle so both elbows are clearly visible. TOP: elbows point up. BOTTOM: elbows open wide, close to the mat.

naam: Hand achter de rug omhoog – met handdoek
pose_en: Frame her from the knees up. She stands upright, seen from BEHIND. A towel hangs vertically down her back: her LEFT hand holds the top of the towel above her left shoulder, her RIGHT hand holds the bottom of the towel behind her lower back. The arrow is a straight arrow at the left hand pointing UP, showing the left hand pulling the towel up.
eind_en: END position: seen from behind, the left hand has pulled the towel up above her head, and the right hand behind her back has slid up to between her shoulder blades.
extra_avatar: Seen from BEHIND, from the knees up, so both hands and the towel on her back are clearly visible.

naam: Arm omhoog brengen in ruglig – met hulp
pose_en: She lies on her BACK on an exercise mat, seen from the side, knees bent, feet flat. Her left hand holds her right wrist, both hands resting on her belly. The arrow is a long curved arrow from her hands going UP and over toward her head, showing both straight arms being raised.
eind_en: END position: still lying on her back, both straight arms raised overhead toward the mat behind her head, the left hand still holding the right wrist.
extra_avatar: BOTTOM: both arms are STRAIGHT (elbows fully extended), raised overhead and resting toward the mat behind her head, the left hand still holding the right wrist. Not hands behind the head.

naam: Schouderbladen plat in ruglig – arm heffen
pose_en: She lies on her BACK on an exercise mat, seen from the side, knees bent, feet flat, arms beside her body, shoulders flat on the mat. The arrow is a curved arrow at her right hand going UP toward the ceiling, showing the straight arm lifting with the thumb leading.
eind_en: END position: still lying on her back, the right arm is straight and points up to the ceiling, thumb leading; the shoulders stay flat on the mat.

naam: Schouderbladen laten zakken en duwen – handen en knieën
pose_en: She is on her hands and knees on an exercise mat, seen from the side, hands under her shoulders, arms straight, her chest SAGGED down between her shoulder blades (shoulder blades squeezed together). The arrow is a straight arrow above her upper back pointing UP.
eind_en: END position: still on hands and knees with straight arms, she has pushed the floor away so her upper back is rounded UP and the shoulder blades are spread apart.
extra_avatar: Seen from the side, framed so the upper back is large. TOP: chest sagged down between the shoulders. BOTTOM: upper back clearly rounded up. Arms stay straight in both.

naam: Bal tegen de muur rollen
pose_en: Frame her from the hips up. She stands facing a wall, seen from the side. Her right arm is straight forward at shoulder height, the palm pressing a ball against the wall. The arrow is a small circular arrow around the ball, showing small circles with the ball.
eind_en: END position: same position, the ball rolled slightly higher on the wall, the arm still straight at shoulder height.
extra_avatar: Frame both figures from the hips up, seen from the side, the ball and wall clearly visible. The ball is slightly higher in the bottom figure.

naam: Leunen op je handen aan tafel
pose_en: Frame her from the knees up. She stands in front of a table, seen from the side, her hands flat on the table with fingers forward, arms straight, leaning her body weight forward onto her hands, shoulder blades low and back. A short straight arrow at her shoulder points DOWN toward her hands.
eind_en: She holds this position: hands flat on the table, arms straight, body weight leaning forward onto the hands, shoulders low.
extra_avatar: Frame her from the knees up, the table clearly visible.

naam: Onderarm naar buiten draaien in ruglig – met hulp (na operatie)
pose_en: She lies on her BACK on an exercise mat, seen from above at an angle, knees bent. Her right upper arm rests beside her body on a cushion, elbow bent 90 degrees, the right forearm resting on her belly. Her left hand holds the right wrist. The arrow is a curved arrow at the right hand going UP and OUTWARD, showing the left hand turning the right forearm outward.
eind_en: END position: still lying on her back, the right elbow stays beside her body on the cushion, the right forearm has been turned outward by the left hand until it points straight up to the ceiling.
extra_avatar: Seen from above at an angle. In BOTH figures the right upper arm lies flat on the cushion beside her body and the right elbow is bent 90 degrees - the arm is never lifted or straightened. TOP: right forearm rests across the belly, left hand on the right wrist. BOTTOM: the right forearm has been rotated outward so it lies flat on the mat pointing away from her body (out to the side), elbow still beside the body, left hand still guiding the wrist.

naam: Schouder naar binnen draaien – isometrisch tegen de muur
pose_en: Frame her from the hips up, seen from the FRONT. She stands at the END of a short wall (an outer wall corner or door post) that stands directly in front of the middle of her body, so the side face of the wall is next to the inside of her right hand. Her right elbow is bent 90 degrees and held against her side, the forearm pointing forward, and the PALM (inside) of her right hand presses sideways against the side face of the wall, toward her belly. Nothing moves. Draw a short straight arrow at the right palm pointing INWARD into the wall, showing the inward push.
eind_en: She holds this position: right elbow bent 90 degrees against her side, palm of the right hand pressing inward against the wall edge, muscles tensed, nothing moves.
extra_avatar: Frame her from the hips up, seen from the front. The right elbow stays against her side and the palm of the right hand is clearly in contact with the side of the wall edge.

naam: Schouder naar binnen draaien – met elastiek
pose_en: Frame her from the hips up, seen in a THREE-QUARTER FRONT view from her right side (her body turned about 45 degrees), so her right arm is large and clearly visible. Her right elbow is bent at a right angle and held against her side; the right forearm points FORWARD and slightly outward, horizontal. Her right hand holds an elastic band that runs straight SIDEWAYS to an anchor on a door at elbow height on her RIGHT side (away from her body). Her left arm hangs relaxed. The arrow is a curved horizontal arrow at the right hand going INWARD toward her belly, showing the forearm turning inward while the elbow stays against her side.
eind_en: END position: same framing and view. The right elbow is still bent at a right angle against her side, but the right forearm now lies ACROSS her belly, the hand in front of her navel, the elastic band stretched tight to the anchor at her right side.
extra_avatar: Frame both figures from the hips up, three-quarter front view. In BOTH figures the right elbow is bent 90 degrees and touches her side. TOP: forearm pointing forward and slightly outward. BOTTOM: forearm across the belly, band taut. The anchor is at her RIGHT side.

naam: Schouder zijwaarts heffen – actief
pose_en: She stands upright, seen from the FRONT, both arms hanging straight beside her body, palms toward her thighs. The arrow is a long curved arrow starting at her RIGHT hand (on the viewer's left) and going SIDEWAYS and UP in an arc to shoulder height, showing the straight right arm being lifted out to the side.
eind_en: END position: seen from the front, her right arm is straight and lifted out to her right SIDE to exactly shoulder height (horizontal), palm facing down. The left arm still hangs beside her body, shoulders level, torso upright.

naam: Schouderblad omhoog draaien – met elastiek
pose_en: She stands upright, seen in a THREE-QUARTER FRONT view from her right side (her body turned about 45 degrees), so her right arm is large and clearly visible. One end of a long elastic band is under her RIGHT foot and she holds the other end in her RIGHT hand; the right arm hangs straight beside her body, thumb pointing forward, the band running straight down to the foot. The arrow is a long curved arrow from the right hand going UP DIAGONALLY - halfway between straight forward and straight sideways - showing the straight arm being lifted in the diagonal plane.
eind_en: END position: same view. The straight right arm is lifted DIAGONALLY (halfway between forward and sideways) to just above shoulder height, thumb pointing up, the elastic band stretched tight from the right hand down to the right foot. Shoulder not shrugged, torso upright.
extra_avatar: Three-quarter front view. TOP: right arm hanging, band slack from hand to foot. BOTTOM: right arm straight and raised diagonally forward-sideways to just above shoulder height, thumb up, band taut in a straight line to the right foot.

naam: Schouder naar buiten draaien – actief
pose_en: Frame her from the hips up, seen in a THREE-QUARTER FRONT view from her right side (her body turned about 45 degrees), so her right arm is large and clearly visible. Her right elbow is bent at a right angle and held against her side; the right forearm points straight FORWARD, horizontal, thumb up, hand empty. Her left arm hangs relaxed. The arrow is a curved horizontal arrow at the right hand going OUTWARD (away from her body), showing the forearm turning outward while the elbow stays against her side.
eind_en: END position: same framing and view. The right elbow is still bent at a right angle and still touches her side, but the right forearm now points OUTWARD to her right side (about 60 degrees out from straight forward), thumb up.
extra_avatar: Frame both figures from the hips up, three-quarter front view. In BOTH figures the right elbow is bent 90 degrees and touches her side. TOP: forearm pointing straight forward. BOTTOM: forearm swung far outward to the side. No band, no equipment.

naam: Horizontaal openen – met elastiek
pose_en: Frame her from the hips up, seen in a THREE-QUARTER FRONT view from her right side (her body turned about 45 degrees), so her right arm is large and clearly visible. BOTH arms are stretched straight FORWARD at shoulder height, hands shoulder-width apart, and she holds a short elastic band stretched lightly between her two hands in front of her chest. The arrow is a curved horizontal arrow at her right hand going OUTWARD and backward, showing the straight arms opening sideways.
eind_en: END position: same framing and view. BOTH straight arms have opened out to the SIDES at shoulder height (a T-shape), the elastic band stretched long across the front of her chest, shoulder blades pulled together, shoulders low.
extra_avatar: Frame both figures from the hips up. TOP: both arms straight forward, short band between the hands. BOTTOM: both arms straight out to the sides in a T, band stretched wide across the chest. Elbows stay straight in both figures.

naam: Schouder pendelen – actief
pose_en: She stands seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right arm is nearest to the viewer. A table stands on her LEFT side (behind her from the viewer) and her LEFT hand leans on it. Her upper body is bent slightly FORWARD from the hips (about 40 degrees), knees soft. Her RIGHT arm hangs completely relaxed and straight DOWN from the shoulder, like a pendulum, hand open. The arrow is a short curved arrow at the right hand swinging FORWARD, showing the arm gently swinging like a pendulum.
eind_en: END position: same side view, same forward-leaning posture with the left hand on the table. The relaxed straight right arm has swung a SMALL distance FORWARD (about 25 degrees from vertical), still hanging loosely, shoulder relaxed.
extra_avatar: Seen from the side. In BOTH figures she leans forward with the left hand on the table. TOP: right arm hanging straight down, vertical. BOTTOM: the relaxed right arm swung a little forward, about 25 degrees. It is a small loose swing, not a lift.
